fulltext_review.title: Potential energy landscape networks of confined vortex matter
fulltext_review.version: PNAS publisher Version of Record, published 2026-10-29
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete seven-page main article, Results, Methods 2.1-2.4, conclusion, references and Figures 1-4 with captions; rendered checks of pages 1, 3-6. Separate SI not read; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 能量景观如何变成网络，帮助理解受限粒子系统的稳定性？
question.en: How can energy-landscape networks help explain stability in confined particle systems?

zh: 今天选它，因为网络的节点是完整的亚稳态构型，而非单个涡旋；先选对状态空间，才谈结构与稳定性的联系。
可借鉴的是把 k-core 分层、度信息量和升温模拟放在一起对照。深核包含基态是文中系统的经验结果，不能当作任意能量景观的定理。
en: The useful move is to make entire metastable configurations the nodes, rather than individual vortices. Choosing the state space makes the structural question precise.
Compare k-core shells and degree information with heating simulations. Ground-state membership in the deepest core is an observation in the studied systems, not a theorem for arbitrary landscapes.

text.zh: 局部能量极小值作节点，一级鞍点连接状态；这种映射把高维构型问题转为可分析的状态网络。
text.en: Local energy minima become nodes and first-order saddles connect states, turning a high-dimensional configuration problem into an analyzable state network.

heading.zh: 比较结构与物理稳定性

text.zh: 将 k-core、度信息量与熔化模拟并置，检查几何、粒子数和约束强度如何共同改变稳定构型。
text.en: Juxtapose k-core structure, degree information and melting simulations to examine how geometry, particle number and confinement jointly change stable configurations.

text.zh: 固定粒子数的 London 点涡旋与硬壁约束给出具体适用条件；强约束下的稳定序列不能只从对称性猜测。
text.en: Fixed-number London point vortices and hard walls define the model scope; under strong confinement, symmetry alone cannot identify the stable sequence.

audience.zh: 研究状态空间网络、网络结构与动力学、能量景观及受限多体系统的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying state-space networks, network structure and dynamics, energy landscapes and confined many-body systems.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读用户提供的正式出版版 7 页全文、结果、方法 2.1–2.4、结论、参考文献及图 1–4，并查看渲染页。独立补充材料未读，未独立复现。结果限于文中点涡旋与约束模型；深核与基态的联系不是普适保证。
reading_caveat.en: Read the user-provided seven-page publisher article, including Results, Methods 2.1-2.4, conclusion, references and Figures 1-4, with rendered-page checks. Separate supporting information was not read and results were not independently reproduced. Findings concern the studied point-vortex confinement models; deep-core membership does not universally guarantee the ground state.

question.zh: 如何在控制活跃度与层密度后，区分多层社会网络中的主动联系分配与他人依赖？
question.en: How can we distinguish outgoing social effort from incoming reliance across relationship layers while accounting for activity and layer density?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把“联系有多少”和“联系分配到哪一层”分开，让多层社会角色的估计对象更明确。
值得借鉴的是同一数据下比较出向与入向角色，再用组成坐标、人口属性和地理关联检验差异。横截面年龄组差异不能直接解释为个体生命周期变化。
en: This paper separates how much people interact from how they distribute interactions across layers, making the role estimand explicit.

A useful workflow compares outgoing and incoming roles on the same data, then checks compositional coordinates, demographic associations and geography. Cross-sectional age-group differences do not establish individual life-course trajectories.

text.zh: 发送者、接收者与层密度效应吸收联系量差异；单纯形因子刻画相对层分配，避免把活跃度当作角色。
text.en: Sender, receiver and layer effects account for activity and density; simplex factors describe relative layer allocation, avoiding an activity-based interpretation of roles.

text.zh: 在同一套有向多层数据中比较两种角色，并用组成坐标分析社会属性与空间组织，适合借鉴为角色分析流程。
text.en: Compare both role directions on the same directed multiplex data, then use compositional coordinates to examine demographic and spatial organization.

text.zh: 村庄横截面样本揭示关联及方向不对称，但不能据此推断因果、个体随年龄的变化或城市网络中的普遍规律。
text.en: The village cross-section reveals associations and directional asymmetries; it does not establish causality, within-person aging trajectories or generality to urban networks.

audience.zh: 研究多层网络、社会角色、网络推断与组成数据分析的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying multiplex networks, social roles, network inference and compositional data analysis.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读正式出版版 11 页正文、方法、讨论与参考文献，核对图 1–5 及图注；未读独立补充信息，未独立复现。数据来自洪都拉斯村庄的非概率横截面样本，并限制于聚合强连通分量；外推到城市或其他关系层尚待验证。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 11-page publisher version, including main text, methods, discussion, references and Figures 1–5 with captions. Separate supporting information was not read and results were not independently reproduced. The nonprobability cross-section of Honduran villages is restricted to the aggregate strongly connected component; generality to urban settings or other relationship layers remains untested.

fulltext_review.title: Neuromodulation-inspired gated associative memory networks: Extended memory retrieval and emergent multistability
fulltext_review.version: PNAS 123 (44) e2607559123, publisher Version of Record; published 2026-10-27
fulltext_review.read_scope: Read all 10 pages: Model and Background, Main Results, thermodynamic-limit DMFT, emergent continuous multistable attractors, Conclusion and Outlook, Materials and Methods, Data availability, Figures 1-4, tables and references. Rendered visual checks of pages 7-8 (Figs. 3-4) and inspected figure captions. Supporting information was not read or executed; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 活动依赖门控如何改变联想记忆网络的容量、稳定性与吸引子几何？
question.en: How does activity-dependent gating change capacity, stability and attractor geometry in associative-memory networks?

zh: 这篇文章把神经调制抽象为乘性门控，展示门控如何把过载网络中的短暂高重叠状态稳定下来，并让最终检索状态连续依赖初始线索。
可复用的方法是将多体模拟与动力学平均场理论相互校验，再用固定随机实现、只改变初始状态的二维流图检查多稳态；但有限斜率门控主要是长寿命状态，二值极限才是永久稳定。
en: The paper models neuromodulation as multiplicative gating and shows how it stabilizes high-overlap transients in overloaded networks, with final retrieval varying continuously with the initial cue.

A useful workflow is to cross-check many-body simulations with dynamical mean-field theory, then hold disorder fixed while varying only the initial state to test multistability. At finite gate slope the states are long-lived; permanence is an idealized binary-limit result.

text.zh: 门控在超过经典容量的区域保持量级为一的检索重叠，绕开无门控网络的灾难性失忆。
text.en: Gating preserves order-one retrieval beyond the classical capacity where the ungated network loses memory.

text.zh: 关闭子群冻结并稳定活跃神经元，解释了短暂吸引子为何可被保留。
text.en: A dynamically selected closed subpopulation stabilizes active neurons and preserves otherwise transient attractor structure.

text.zh: 固定网络实现并只改变初始状态的流图显示，门控网络可形成连续的稳定固定点云。
text.en: Flow diagrams with fixed disorder and varied initial states show a continuous cloud of stable fixed points.

audience.zh: 研究联想记忆、递归网络、网络动力学和神经形态计算的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying associative memory, recurrent networks, network dynamics and neuromorphic computing.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读出版社正式版 10 页正文、图 1–4、方法、数据声明与参考文献，并检查图 3–4 页面；未读补充信息，未运行代码或独立复现。有限门控斜率下稳定性是长寿命而非永久；模型采用全连接 Hebbian 耦合和随机门控耦合，生物适用性仍需结构化连接数据检验。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 10-page publisher Version of Record, Figs. 1-4, methods, data statement and references, with visual checks of the pages containing Figs. 3-4. Supplementary information was not read and code was not run or independently reproduced. Finite gate slopes yield long-lived rather than permanent states; the model uses fully connected Hebbian couplings and random gate couplings, so biological applicability still needs structured connectivity data.

fulltext_review.title: Propagating shocks and transitions across networked food systems: Insights from multiplayer microeconomic modeling
fulltext_review.version: PNAS 123 (44), e2321155123, publisher Version of Record; published online 2026-10-26
fulltext_review.read_scope: Read all 10 pages: main text, DECO model, four case studies, Discussion and Conclusions, Table 1, Figures 1–4, data statement and references; rendered visual checks of network, flow and regional scenario figures. Supplementary equations and external model/code were not read or executed; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 局部旱灾或政策变化，如何经市场和运输网络改变远处群体的粮食安全？
question.en: How do local droughts and policy changes alter distant food security through markets and transport networks?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把“冲击沿网络传播”落实到生产者、仓储商、运输商和消费者的不同目标，说明总产量增加与弱势群体受益并不等价。
值得借鉴的是先拆分生产区与市场区，再追踪价格、流量和福利的变化；同时把反事实基线、需求弹性与行为假设写清，避免把情景模型当作精确预测。
en: I recommend this Perspective because it makes network shock propagation concrete through the different objectives of producers, storage operators, distributors and consumers; greater total supply need not benefit vulnerable groups.

A reusable approach is to separate production zones from marketsheds, then trace prices, flows and welfare. Keep the counterfactual baseline, demand elasticities and behavioral assumptions explicit when interpreting scenarios.

heading.zh: 把传播路径与行动者放在一起

text.zh: DECO 显式连接农业区、市场与道路基础设施，用多参与者目标解释冲击如何跨区域传递。
text.en: DECO explicitly connects production zones, markets and roads, using multiple actor objectives to explain regional transmission.

heading.zh: 检查谁获益、谁承受成本
heading.en: Track who gains and who bears costs

text.zh: 运输扩容、出口放松和灌溉案例展示总量指标之外的分配效应，提醒网络韧性分析同时观察消费和收益。
text.en: Transport, export and irrigation scenarios reveal distributional effects that aggregate indicators miss; examine consumption and income alongside system totals.

text.zh: 需求弹性、理性行为与局部均衡假设影响结论；埃塞俄比亚到马里的迁移也需要重建本地数据与参数。
text.en: Demand elasticities, rational behavior and partial-equilibrium assumptions shape the results; transfer from Ethiopia to Mali requires local data and parameterization.

audience.zh: 研究网络韧性、级联冲击、社会生态系统和跨部门情景建模的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying network resilience, cascading shocks, socioecological systems and cross-sector scenario modeling.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读出版社正式版 10 页正文、表 1、图 1–4、讨论与参考文献；未读补充方程，未运行模型或独立复现。本文为 Perspective，综合既有案例；DECO 依赖区域数据、需求弹性和行为假设，结果用于反事实情景比较，不是精确政策预测。AI 编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 10-page publisher Version of Record, including Table 1, Figs. 1–4, discussion and references. Supplementary equations were not read and the model was not run or independently reproduced. This Perspective synthesizes earlier cases; DECO depends on local data, demand elasticities and behavioral assumptions and supports counterfactual scenario comparison rather than precise policy prediction. AI editorial guidance.

fulltext_review.version: Nature Communications Article in Press, published online 2026-10-25; publisher reference PDF
fulltext_review.read_scope: Read all 11 pages: abstract, Introduction, DenseAM and diffusion-model theory, four natural-data experiments, 2D toy model, Stable Diffusion case, Discussion, Methods, Data and Code availability, references; visually checked representative Figs. 1–7. Supplementary materials and external code were not read or executed; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 扩散模型从记忆到泛化的转变，能否用联想记忆网络的能量景观解释？
question.en: Can associative-memory energy landscapes explain how diffusion models move from memorization to generalization?

zh: 我推荐它，因为文章把 Dense Associative Memory、Hopfield 能量景观与扩散模型放进同一个网络动力学框架，直接追踪记忆化、伪状态和生成式泛化之间的关系。
可复用的阅读路径是先看能量景观和容量预测，再对照 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、LSUN-CHURCH 与 Stable Diffusion 案例，最后检查理想化 score 学习假设是否限制解释范围。
en: I recommend this paper because it places Dense Associative Memory, Hopfield energy landscapes and diffusion models in one network-dynamics framework, tracing memorization, spurious states and generative generalization together.

A reusable reading path is to start with the energy landscape and capacity predictions, compare the MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, LSUN-CHURCH and Stable Diffusion cases, then check how the idealized score-learning assumptions limit the interpretation.

heading.zh: 把扩散过程写成吸引子动力学

text.zh: DenseAM/Hopfield 能量景观提供了连接记忆检索、伪状态和生成过程的统一语言。
text.en: DenseAM and Hopfield energy landscapes provide one language for memory retrieval, spurious states and generation.

heading.zh: 用多层数据检验相变图景

text.zh: 从二维 toy model 到四个自然数据集再到 Stable Diffusion，逐层检查理论现象是否出现。
text.en: The paper checks the proposed picture from a 2D toy model through four natural datasets to Stable Diffusion.

text.zh: 作者指出理论依赖理想化 score 学习条件，也没有证明伪状态是泛化的因果驱动。
text.en: The authors state that the theory relies on idealized score learning and does not establish spurious states as a causal driver of generalization.

audience.zh: 扩散模型、联想记忆、网络动力学与生成模型理论研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in diffusion models, associative memory, network dynamics and generative-model theory.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读出版社 11 页 Article in Press 参考 PDF，覆盖正文、方法、图 1–7、数据与代码说明及参考文献；补充材料与外部代码未读或执行，也未独立复现。理论依赖理想化 score 学习条件，伪状态与泛化的因果关系仍未被证明；后续 Version of Record 可能替换当前版本。AI 编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read all 11 pages of the publisher Article in Press reference PDF, including the main text, Methods, Figs. 1–7, data and code statements, and references; supplements and external code were not read or executed, and no independent reproduction was performed. The theory relies on idealized score learning, and a causal role for spurious states in generalization is not established; a later Version of Record may replace this version. AI editorial guidance.

fulltext_review.title: Recommendation system-inspired learning of crossmodal interaction patterns between chromatin accessibility and gene expression

question.zh: 推荐系统的稀疏交互思想，怎样帮助我们学习细粒度的基因调控图？
question.en: How can sparse interaction ideas from recommender systems help learn fine-grained gene-regulatory graphs?

zh: 我推荐它，因为文章把每个细胞的染色质可及性与基因表达重写成二部交互图，再用带生物属性的图 Transformer 学习 peak–gene 关系；这让“图模型如何服务具体机制问题”变得很清楚。
可复用的建模经验是把节点属性、先验边和稀疏监督分开做消融，并用跨细胞类型、跨数据集的零样本测试检查迁移。文中结果仍是计算基准与生物学解释，不能替代实验验证。
en: I recommend this paper because it recasts each cell’s chromatin accessibility and gene expression as a bipartite interaction graph, then uses a biology-aware graph transformer to learn peak–gene links. It makes the path from graph modeling to a concrete mechanism question unusually clear.

A reusable design is to ablate node attributes, prior edges and sparse supervision separately, then test transfer across unseen cell types and datasets. The evidence is computational benchmarking plus biological interpretation; it does not replace experimental validation.

heading.zh: 把跨模态关系显式成图

text.zh: RNA 节点与 ATAC 节点组成二部图，边和属性分别承载先验与生物信息。
text.en: Represent RNA and ATAC nodes in a bipartite graph, keeping prior edges and biological attributes distinct.

heading.en: Test where the signal comes from

text.zh: 分别移除属性、先验边、方向注意力和剪枝模块，观察性能与可解释性如何变化。
text.en: Remove attributes, prior edges, directional attention and pruning separately to track their effects on performance and interpretation.

text.zh: 跨未见细胞类型和跨数据集直接测试，检验模型是否学到可迁移的调控模式。
text.en: Test unseen cell types and cross-dataset transfer without fine-tuning to ask whether learned regulatory patterns travel.

audience.zh: 图机器学习、网络推断、单细胞多组学与调控网络建模研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in graph learning, network inference, single-cell multi-omics and regulatory-network modeling.

reading_caveat.en: Read all 25 pages of the publisher Article in Press PDF, including main text, Methods, Figs. 1-8 and equations; supplements, source data and code were not read or executed, and no independent reproduction was performed. The article page says this version may be replaced by the final Version of Record. AI editorial guidance.

fulltext_review.title: Emergence and coexistence of periodic and unstructured motion in future-avoiding random walks
fulltext_review.version: Physical Review E 114, 044219 (2026), publisher version published online 2026-10-23
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete 7-page publisher article: main text, Methods, equations, Figs. 1-5 and captions, Discussion and Conclusion, Acknowledgments, Data Availability and references; all seven rendered pages inspected. Separate Supplemental Material and external code were not read or executed; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 未来驱动的路径互动，怎样自发形成周期与无序共存？
question.en: How can future-driven path interactions self-organize periodic and unstructured motion?

zh: 今天选它，因为论文把网络上的路径互动与共享出行联系起来：车辆不是回避走过的历史，而是在分配请求时相互避让计划中的未来轨迹。周期路线和无序路线因此可以在同一系统中共存。
可借用的分析顺序是先用边使用率检验单路线结构，再用加权复现图识别周期性，最后用环网络上的方向改变概率建立近似。这样能把“看起来有规律”拆成结构指标、动力学状态和机制解释。
en: I recommend this paper because it connects network path interactions with shared mobility: routes avoid one another’s planned futures during request assignment, allowing periodic and unstructured routes to coexist in one system.

A reusable workflow is to test single-route structure with link usage, detect periodicity with value-weighted recurrence plots, and then build a direction-change approximation on a ring. It separates visual regularity, dynamical state and mechanism.

heading.zh: 把路径互动写成网络动力学
heading.en: Model path interactions as network dynamics

text.zh: 未来轨迹的相互避让把请求分配、路线记忆和网络拓扑连在一起，适合研究非振荡个体如何出现集体结构。
text.en: Future-trajectory avoidance links request assignment, route memory and topology, offering a way to study collective structure without intrinsically oscillatory units.

heading.zh: 用复现图区分周期与无序

text.zh: 加权复现矩阵保留重复节点的身份，平均对角线长度再给出路线周期性比例，比只看时间序列更容易定位结构。
text.en: A value-weighted recurrence matrix keeps recurring node identities, while mean diagonal length quantifies periodicity more directly than a time series alone.

text.zh: 环网络上的方向改变概率准确抓住转变位置，但高估转变陡峭度，提醒我们把近似的趋势和精确预测分开报告。
text.en: The ring approximation captures the transition location but overestimates its sharpness, a useful reminder to report trends separately from exact prediction.

audience.zh: 网络动力学、路径规划、时间网络与共享出行建模研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network dynamics, routing, temporal networks and shared-mobility modeling.

question.zh: 关系不断切换时，什么结构能让合作更容易演化？
question.en: Which changing network structures make cooperation easier to evolve?

zh: 选它是因为它提供了一个可复用的拆解方式：先固定网络切换、更新规则和突变设置，把它们的影响写成三个结构系数，再比较不同收益矩阵。对要扫描多种博弈的研究，这比每次重新展开整套模型更有启发。
另一点值得借用的是对照设计：用同构静态网络的不同节点配置隔离时间变化的作用，再扫描切换速度。动态核周结构提示，结构优势在人之间轮换也能影响合作；不能只看静态中心性或一张聚合图。
en: This paper offers a reusable decomposition: fix network switching, updating and mutation, encode their effects in three structure coefficients, then compare payoff matrices. That separation is especially useful when studying several games under one temporal-network mechanism.

Borrow its control design as well: compare isomorphic static configurations to isolate temporality, then scan switching rates. Rotating access to core positions can change cooperation, so static centrality or one aggregate graph may miss the mechanism.

text.zh: 弱选择下以三个系数组织网络、更新与突变影响，便于比较多种博弈。
text.en: Under weak selection, three coefficients organize network, update and mutation effects for comparisons across games.

text.zh: 用同构静态配置和切换速度扫描，区分结构本身与结构轮换的贡献。
text.en: Use isomorphic static controls and switching-rate scans to separate structure from its temporal rotation.

text.zh: 系数来自中性两、三节点概率等线性系统，模型压缩不等于常数计算成本。
text.en: Coefficients require neutral two- and three-node probability systems; a compact theorem does not imply constant computational cost.

audience.zh: 演化博弈、时间网络、合作演化与随机过程建模研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in evolutionary games, temporal networks, cooperation and stochastic-process modeling.

question.zh: 简单的节点状态，怎样产生不均匀的群体互动？
question.en: How can simple node states generate uneven group interactions?

zh: 今天选它，因为复杂时间统计未必需要先假定复杂记忆：节点只在高、低活跃间切换，群体层面就能出现更长的事件间隔尾部和缓慢自相关。这个从微观机制推到可观测量的过程很适合作为建模起点。
可借用的思路是先建立可解析的最小基线，再同时检查事件率、间隔变异系数和自相关，并按群体规模分层。多项趋势相似仍不意味着已经识别真实生成规则。
en: This paper makes a useful modeling point: complex event statistics need not begin with complex memory. Nodes switching between high and low activity can already yield longer event-time tails and slowly decaying autocorrelation at group level.
Borrow its minimal analytic baseline, then check event rates, interval variability and autocorrelation together across group sizes. Similar trends do not identify the true generating rule.

text.zh: 比较全员高活跃的 AND 规则与按活跃比例变化的 LIN 规则，明确群体事件如何产生。
text.en: Compare an all-members-high AND rule with a high-state-fraction LIN rule to make event generation explicit.

heading.zh: 用多个统计量约束模型

text.zh: 联合看事件率、间隔变异系数和自相关，减少单一长尾图带来的机制误判。
text.en: Combine event rates, interval variability and autocorrelation instead of inferring mechanisms from one tail plot.

text.zh: 实证比较是定性检验；允许参数随群体规模变化时，不同规则可给出相似趋势。
text.en: Empirical checks are qualitative; different rules can resemble each other when rates vary with group size.

audience.zh: 时间网络、高阶互动、事件序列建模及传播动力学研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in temporal networks, higher-order interactions, event sequences and spreading dynamics.

question.zh: 圈内协同与跨圈确认并存时，结构多样性会怎样改变传播相变？
question.en: How does structural diversity reshape contagion when reinforcement acts within and across social circles?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把常被分开处理的两类高阶强化放进同一模型：圈内多人协同与跨圈多源确认。两者竞争使结构多样性的作用呈U形，而非简单的单调促进或抑制。
最值得复用的是它的机制拆分和验证链：固定度序列只重排邻域结构，用消息传递推导阈值，再以双初值滞后、Monte Carlo和有限尺寸标度交叉检查。
en: Today's pick combines two higher-order mechanisms that are often studied separately: synergy within a circle and confirmation across circles. Their competition makes structural diversity produce a U-shaped response instead of a simple monotonic effect.

Its reusable lesson is the validation chain: alter neighborhood structure while preserving degree, derive thresholds by message passing, then cross-check with two-initial-condition hysteresis, Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling.

text.zh: 把圈内协同与跨圈确认写成独立机制，避免用一个高阶参数混合不同社会强化。
text.en: Model within-circle synergy and cross-circle confirmation separately instead of blending distinct reinforcement mechanisms.

text.zh: 保持度序列和全局连通，只调节邻域连通分量，用于隔离结构多样性的作用。
text.en: Preserve degree and global connectivity while tuning neighborhood components to isolate structural diversity.

text.zh: 结合理论阈值、双初值滞后、模拟和有限尺寸标度，区分真实突变与数值假象。
text.en: Combine thresholds, two-initial-condition hysteresis, simulation and finite-size scaling to test abrupt transitions.

audience.zh: 高阶网络、社会传播、消息传递方法及相变研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in higher-order networks, social contagion, message passing and phase transitions.

question.zh: 预测得准，推断出的网络就可靠吗？
question.en: Does accurate prediction make an inferred network reliable?

zh: 今天选它，因为网络推断很容易只报告一个漂亮的预测分数。这份复用研究把注意力转向：换一批样本、删去部分先验后，哪些结构仍然站得住？
可以借用它的验证思路：分别测量预测表现与结构稳定性，再用先验扰动、重复求解和聚合对照定位脆弱环节。稳定的结果仍不等于真实的因果网络。
en: Today’s pick tackles a common blind spot in network inference: a strong prediction score can hide fragile structure. What remains when samples change or prior edges are missing?

Borrow its separation of prediction from structural stability, then use prior perturbations, repeated solves and aggregation controls to locate weaknesses. Stable outputs still do not establish a true causal network.

text.zh: 区分预测、结构一致性和生物真实性，避免把同一种分数当成全部证据。
text.en: Distinguish prediction, structural consistency and biological truth rather than relying on one score.

text.zh: 改变先验完整性与样本组合，检查结论对数据和约束有多敏感。
text.en: Vary prior completeness and sample composition to expose sensitivity to data and constraints.

text.zh: 用聚合降低求解波动，用选择性回补检查过度剪枝的信息损失。
text.en: Use aggregation against solver variability and selective re-expansion to probe pruning losses.

audience.zh: 网络重构、生物网络及关心模型稳健性和可复现性的研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network reconstruction, biological networks and model robustness.

question.zh: 优先连接允许落点偏移后，经典网络结构还稳健吗？
question.en: Does preferential attachment remain robust when the final endpoint can shift?

zh: 今天回选它，因为一个很小的机制改变，就能检验经典模型里常被忽略的假设：新节点选中的目标，是否必须就是最终的连接端点。
值得借鉴的是把选择与落边分开建模，用固定重定向作对照，再检查有限尺寸效应。读者也能学习如何区分严格结果、数值证据与猜想。
en: Today’s archive pick uses a small mechanism change to test an overlooked assumption: must the initially selected node also be the final attachment endpoint?

Borrow its separation of target selection from edge placement, constant-redirection controls and finite-size checks. Its explicit distinction between rigorous results, numerical evidence and conjectures is equally useful.

text.zh: 先选目标，再允许局部重定向；微观规则的细节可能改变宏观拓扑。
text.en: Select a target, then allow local redirection: details of microscopic rules can change macroscopic topology.

text.zh: 固定与度依赖重定向并列比较，帮助辨认结构变化来自哪项假设。
text.en: Compare constant and degree-dependent redirection to identify which assumption drives structural changes.

text.zh: 将定理、模拟与猜想分别标明；临界附近的有限尺寸偏差尤其值得留意。
text.en: Label theorems, simulations and conjectures separately, with particular care near finite-size crossovers.

audience.zh: 网络增长、生成模型、优先连接及理论与模拟结合的研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network growth, generative models, preferential attachment and theory–simulation comparisons.

question.zh: 重构出调控网络后，怎样找出协同工作的模块？
question.en: After reconstructing a regulatory network, how do we find cooperating modules?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络重构与模块解释接起来：保留不同伪时间滞后的调控信息，再识别共同作用的转录因子与靶基因，而不只交付一张静态连边图。
可复用的思路是先用生物先验约束候选边，再以张量表达多尺度关系，并分别检验边恢复、关键节点和稳定性。推断关联仍需实验验证。
en: Today’s pick connects network reconstruction to module interpretation: retain regulation across pseudotime lags, then identify cooperating transcription factors and target programs instead of stopping at a static edge map.

Borrow its sequence of prior-constrained inference, tensor representation and separate checks of edge recovery, key regulators and stability. Inferred associations still require experimental validation.

text.zh: 将因子、靶基因与伪时间滞后组成张量，用Tucker分解识别协同调控程序。
text.en: Represent factors, targets and pseudotime lags as a tensor; use Tucker decomposition to identify regulatory programs.

text.zh: 用染色质可及性与结合基序限定候选边，并检查移除先验后的表现。
text.en: Restrict candidate edges with chromatin accessibility and binding motifs, and compare inference without this prior.

text.zh: 同时考察连边、关键因子与稳定性；AUPR优势不等于所有F1比较都显著。
text.en: Check edges, key regulators and stability separately; favorable AUPR does not imply significant gains in every F1 comparison.

question.zh: 一场局部暴雨，怎样演变成全网延误？
question.en: How can local rainfall become network-wide delay?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把降雨这个外部空间场接入网络动力学，让“哪里下雨”和“延误怎样传播、被吸收”在同一模型里相遇。它为气候风险与基础设施韧性研究提供了一条可复用的建模路径。
值得带走的是：拆分扰动生成、传播和吸收，按时间留出数据检验，再区分动态脆弱性与人口加权风险。模型的崩溃相不能当成真实铁路已被验证的崩溃阈值。
en: Today’s pick couples a spatial rainfall field to network dynamics, connecting where disruption originates with how delays spread and dissipate. It offers a reusable modeling route for climate risk and infrastructure resilience.

Borrow the separation of generation, propagation and absorption; validate on later data; and distinguish dynamic vulnerability from population-weighted risk. A model collapse regime is not an empirically established threshold for real railways.

heading.en: Put the external field into dynamics

text.zh: 沿线路累计降雨影响，把局部冲击与网络传播、容量吸收明确分开。
text.en: Integrate rainfall along links and separate local forcing from network propagation and capacity-driven absorption.

text.zh: 用后续年份测试，并报告少雨日和不同铁路系统上预测失效的边界。
text.en: Test on later data and report limits on low-rain days and across different railway systems.

text.zh: 局部扰动后的全网延误，再乘人口暴露，可得到不同于中心性的治理优先序。
text.en: Combine network-wide delay after local shocks with population exposure to obtain priorities beyond centrality.

audience.zh: 网络韧性、级联传播、交通网络与气候风险研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network resilience, cascades, transportation and climate risk.

question.zh: 从时间序列生成的网络，怎样才算具有记忆？
question.en: When does a network built from time series have memory?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把序模式转移网络与储备池计算联系起来，并追问“记忆”究竟对应哪个状态、怎样测量。对用网络表示时间序列的研究者，这比再增加一个预测精度指标更有启发。
可复用的是三步检查：先把必要历史纳入状态，再用经验混合时间检查遗忘速度，最后按合法后继集合设随机基线。结构约束带来的高准确率，不能直接当成学习能力。
en: Today’s pick connects ordinal-pattern transition networks with reservoir computing and asks which state carries memory and how to measure it. This offers a useful framework for researchers who represent time series as networks.

Borrow three checks: include the necessary history in the state, measure empirical mixing, and set chance performance using legal successors. High accuracy created by structural constraints should not be mistaken for learned predictive skill.

text.zh: 延迟嵌入需要保留兼容历史；单个序模式不足以描述完整记忆。
text.en: Delay embedding requires a compatibility history; one ordinal pattern is not the complete memory state.

text.zh: 结合谱隙与直接迭代的混合时间，警惕理论上界在有限样本下过松。
text.en: Pair the spectral gap with directly measured mixing time; theoretical bounds can be loose for finite samples.

text.zh: 用每步合法后继集合计算机会水平，避免把编码限制误判为预测优势。
text.en: Compute chance from each step’s legal successors to separate coding constraints from predictive gains.

audience.zh: 时间序列网络、符号动力学、储备池计算与网络推断研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in time-series networks, symbolic dynamics, reservoir computing and network inference.

This Perspective uses one-step ordinal prediction as illustration, not a superiority benchmark against optimized reservoirs. Fading memory requires ergodicity conditions. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 干预改变行为，也会改变传播的网络吗？
question.en: Does an intervention also rewire its network?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络从干预的固定背景变成了需要测量的结果：在110个村落的随机健康教育试验中，总体度分布稳定，关系却随干预覆盖程度选择性地形成与断裂。
可借鉴的是分析顺序：先跟踪哪些边改变，再区分自己与邻居的干预暴露，最后检验变化是否跨关系类型、跨时间持续。只报告平均度，可能错过最有意义的变化。
en: Today’s pick treats the network as an intervention outcome. In a randomized health-education trial across 110 villages, aggregate degree distributions remained stable while ties selectively formed and dissolved with treatment coverage.

Borrow the analysis sequence: track changing edges, distinguish personal and neighboring exposure, then test persistence across relationship layers and time. Mean degree alone can miss the informative changes.

text.zh: 分别检查关系形成、维持和断裂，辨认被总体平均掩盖的连接重组。
text.en: Separate tie formation, persistence and dissolution to reveal rewiring hidden by aggregate averages.

text.zh: 两阶段随机化配合网络暴露分组，区分直接与溢出效应，并明确村间无干扰假设。
text.en: Pair two-stage randomization with exposure groups to distinguish direct and spillover effects, stating the no-between-village-interference assumption.

text.zh: 比较健康咨询、友谊和财务关系及后续随访，结合多重检验约束机制解释。
text.en: Compare advice, friendship and financial ties over follow-up, using multiple-testing checks to constrain mechanistic interpretations.

audience.zh: 社会网络、网络干预、传播与因果推断研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in social networks, interventions, spreading and causal inference.

reading_caveat.en: Read all 28 PDF pages, including Methods, Extended Data and embedded Reporting Summary; separate SI not read, no reproduction. Network outcomes are secondary analysis with exploratory dose grouping; self-reported ties and one regional setting limit generalization. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 怎样调局部速率，才能控制全局网络流？
question.en: How can local rates control global network flows?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络控制中常见的问题说具体了：改变一条边的跃迁速率，怎样影响全局流量与波动？论文给出统一的涨落响应框架，并用分子马达网络演示控制设计。
最值得带走的是先选独立观测量，再拆解噪声来源，最后检查控制的副作用。这条分析路径也能启发其他随机网络的模型设计。
en: Today’s pick makes a recurring control problem concrete: how does changing an edge’s transition rate alter global flows and fluctuations? A unified fluctuation–response framework connects these quantities and demonstrates control in a molecular-motor network.
Borrow the sequence: choose independent observables, identify noise sources, then check control side effects. This offers a reusable way to reason about other stochastic network models.

text.zh: 区分双向通量、净流与驻留概率，排除守恒带来的冗余，明确真正要控制的量。
text.en: Separate traffic, net flux and dwell probabilities; remove conservation redundancies before defining the control target.

text.zh: 分子马达案例区分等待时间与路径分支的贡献，提示不同负载下该调哪些跃迁。
text.en: The motor example separates timing and branching contributions, suggesting which transitions to target at different loads.

text.zh: 局部边、节点和循环调节协议展示如何改变目标观测量，并保持其余选定量不变。
text.en: Local edge, node and cycle protocols change a target observable while preserving the other selected observables.

audience.zh: 随机网络、非平衡动力学、网络流与控制研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in stochastic networks, nonequilibrium dynamics, network flows and control.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读7页正式全文，未读独立补充材料，未复现。框架针对长时稳态Markov跃迁网络；稠密图无普遍效率优势，形式对称性不意味着一般参数下的互易关系。AI编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read the seven-page version of record, not separate supplements; no reproduction. The framework concerns long-time stationary Markov jump networks. Dense graphs have no general efficiency advantage, and formal symmetry does not imply reciprocity for arbitrary parameters. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 拿不到完整流量，怎样重建一张可用的网络？
question.en: How can aggregate flows reconstruct a useful network?

zh: 今天选它，因为它直面网络研究常见的资料瓶颈：只有节点总量和区域信息，怎样生成可用于传播分析的稀疏加权网络？航空案例把约束选择、模型构造和任务检验连成一条清晰路径。
最值得复用的是分层验证：匹配已有约束之后，还要检查连接、空间模式和传播曲线。开放数据实验也提醒我们，先交代校准信息，再讨论重建效果。
en: Today’s pick addresses a recurring bottleneck: reconstructing a sparse weighted network from aggregate location and regional flows. Its aviation case connects constraint selection, model construction and epidemic-task validation.

Borrow the layered checks: after matching imposed constraints, test links, spatial patterns and spreading curves. The open-data experiment also makes it essential to state which calibration information remains available.

text.zh: 区分直接航班与实际起终点出行，避免把中转枢纽的流量当作最终人口混合。
text.en: Distinguish flight legs from origin-to-final-destination trips; transit-hub traffic need not represent population mixing.

text.zh: 先生成稀疏连接，再分配流量；节点强度与区域约束各自承担明确的模型角色。
text.en: Sample sparse links before assigning flows, giving location strengths and regional constraints explicit modeling roles.

text.zh: 对照真实网络上的传播峰值与空间分布，并将误差和随机模拟的自身波动比较。
text.en: Compare epidemic peaks and spatial patterns against the empirical network, using intrinsic simulation variability as a baseline.

audience.zh: 网络重构、加权网络、人口流动与传播动力学研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network reconstruction, weighted networks, mobility and spreading dynamics.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读9页官方早期在线全文，未读独立补充材料，未复现。网络基于2019年数据；开放数据测试仅覆盖739个区域，且连接密度仍按OAG校准，不能视为完全独立的开放数据重建。AI编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 9-page publisher Article in Press, not separate supplements; no reproduction. Networks use 2019 data. The open-data test covers 739 basins and still calibrates connectivity density against OAG; it is not a fully independent open-data reconstruction. AI editorial guidance.

fulltext_review.title: Fluidic Hysterons and Memory in Flow Networks
fulltext_review.version: Physical Review X 16, 041011 (2026), publisher Version of Record, published 2026-10-09
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete 11-page publisher PDF: Introduction, sections II–VI, Methods A–F, Equations 1–2, Figures 1–5 and captions, note added, data availability and all references. Rendered page5 (Fig4, state-transition graphs) and page6 (Eq2, Fig5, collective memory) visually inspected. Separate Supplemental Material and movies not read; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 网络出现记忆，是单元的性质，还是耦合的结果？
question.en: Does network memory come from its elements or their coupling?

zh: 今天回选它，因为一个可调旁路就能把独立的迟滞单元变成相互作用网络，清楚展示局部形变如何经全局流量约束改变集体切换。它让“耦合从何而来”成为可以控制和检验的问题。
值得借鉴的是它的证据分层：先建立单元与无耦合基线，再比较状态切换路径和平均响应。尤其要注意，平均曲线越出原包络时，测试中的完整状态仍能恢复；不同的记忆判据不能互相替代。
en: Today’s archive pick uses a tunable bypass to turn independent hysterons into an interacting network. Local deformation changes collective switching through a global flow constraint, making the origin of coupling experimentally testable.

Borrow its layered checks: establish the element and uncoupled baseline, then compare state paths with average responses. Crossing the original envelope coexists with full-state recovery in tested protocols; different memory criteria are not interchangeable.

text.zh: 用流量与压差平衡解释远处单元为何相互影响，不把物理距离或直接接触当作唯一连接依据。
text.en: Use flow and pressure balance to explain distant interactions; physical proximity or contact need not define the effective coupling.

text.zh: 固定总流量时，无旁路串联单元可独立；固定总压差时则未必。对照必须和驱动方式一起定义。
text.en: Series elements can be independent without a bypass under fixed flow, but not necessarily under fixed pressure. Define the baseline with the drive.

heading.zh: 完整状态核验平均读数

text.zh: 结合切换图与状态向量区分反向切换、包络越界和回返点恢复，避免一条平均曲线承担多个结论。
text.en: Combine transition graphs and state vectors to distinguish counterswitching, envelope crossing and return-point recovery; one average curve cannot establish all three.

audience.zh: 网络动力学、集体记忆、流动网络与软物质研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network dynamics, collective memory, flow networks and soft matter.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读11页官方全文，未读独立补充材料和视频。结论基于低雷诺数、准静态流量驱动及有限阵列；复杂拓扑是后续方向。所测回返点均恢复，不能声称严格回返点记忆失效。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 11-page publisher article, not separate supplements or movies. Results concern low-Reynolds-number, quasistatic flow driving and finite arrays; complex topologies remain future work. Tested return points recover, so strict return-point memory failure is not established. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

fulltext_review.title: Mesoscale structures in signed networks
fulltext_review.version: Science Advances 12, eaee5886 (2026), publisher Version of Record, published 2026-10-09
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete 15-page publisher PDF: article pages 1–14 and final publisher information page; Introduction, Results, Discussion, Materials and Methods, equations, Figures 1–9, Table 1, captions, references and declarations. Rendered page 2 (Equations 1–2, Fig. 1) and page 9 (Fig. 9) inspected. Separate Supplementary Materials not read; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 发现的平衡结构，来自数据还是算法的预设？
question.en: Does a balanced partition come from the data or the algorithm’s assumptions?

zh: 今天回选它，因为它提出一个直接影响网络分析结论的问题：如果算法本来就在寻找平衡分组，找到平衡能否算作理论证据？论文用18类群组关系和24个实证网络，让常被忽略的不平衡组织显现。
值得复用的是检验顺序：先检查方法预设，再比较带符号与无符号模型，最后分别评估三角形和群组尺度。它提醒我们，漂亮的分组结果也需要对照与不确定性。
en: Today’s archive pick asks a consequential question: if an algorithm seeks balanced groups, does finding them support balance theory? Its 18 pairwise relationship types and 24 empirical networks expose overlooked unbalanced organization.

Borrow the sequence: inspect methodological assumptions, compare signed and unsigned models, then assess triangles and groups separately. An appealing partition still needs controls and uncertainty checks.

text.zh: 对照平衡导向方法与度修正SBM，用已知分组的合成网络检验结果是否被目标函数牵引。
text.en: Contrast balance-oriented methods with degree-corrected SBMs, using synthetic networks with known groups to test objective-driven conclusions.

text.zh: 比较带符号模型与“无符号拓扑＋独立符号”基线的描述长度，不默认正负标签一定改善分组。
text.en: Compare description lengths against an unsigned-topology plus independent-sign baseline; do not assume signs necessarily improve grouping.

text.zh: 同时检查三角形平衡与群组挫折度；保留介观结构的零模型，再报告分组和关系类型的不确定性。
text.en: Check triadic balance and group-level frustration separately, use block-preserving null models, and report partition and type uncertainty.

audience.zh: 有符号网络、社区发现、社会平衡及实证网络研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in signed networks, community detection, social balance and empirical network analysis.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读15页官方PDF，未读另附补充材料。实证比较采用最大连通分量、无向化及二值化；关系类型依赖分组和模型，部分案例存在替代分组。结构解释不等于因果或传播验证。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 15-page publisher PDF, not separate supplements. Empirical comparisons use largest connected components, symmetrization and binarization. Types depend on partitions and models; some cases admit alternatives. Structural interpretations are not causal or diffusion tests. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

fulltext_review.title: Contagion-preserving compression for multiscale epidemic modeling
fulltext_review.version: Science Advances 12, eadz4710 (2026), publisher Version of Record, published 2026-10-09
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete 17-page PDF: article pages 1–16 and final publisher information page; main text, Methods, equations, Figures 1–8 and captions, references and declarations. Rendered page 4 (Eq. 4–6, Fig. 2) and page 7 (Fig. 4) inspected. Separate Supplementary Materials not read; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 网络缩小之后，哪些传播规律还能保留下来？
question.en: Which contagion properties survive when a network is compressed?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络压缩与传播机制直接联系起来：密集团何时可作为传播单元，合并后的边又该如何传递感染？这让粗粒化的选择有了可检查的动力学依据。
值得带走的是一套验证步骤：同时检查疫情规模、节点感染风险与传播时间，再按误差容忍度选择压缩尺度。做大网络模拟或干预设计时，这比只比较最终规模更有参考价值。
en: Today’s pick ties network compression to contagion mechanisms: when can a dense clique act as one spreading unit, and how should merged edges transmit infection? These questions give coarse-graining a checkable dynamical basis.

Borrow its validation workflow: compare outbreak size, node-level risk and timing, then choose compression scales under an error tolerance. This is useful for large-network simulation and intervention design.

heading.zh: 从传播机制定义粗粒化

text.zh: 检查块内感染是否近饱和，并按原始跨块边数合成传播概率，而非直接沿用原网络的感染率。
text.en: Check near-saturation within blocks and aggregate transmission probabilities using original interblock edges, rather than reusing the original rate.

text.zh: 同时比较总规模与节点风险；时间轨迹另需全局对齐，不能把对齐后的吻合视为原始时间完全一致。
text.en: Compare aggregate size and node-level risk; trajectories require global time alignment, which is not identity in unshifted time.

text.zh: 先在粗粒化网络定位关键区域，再映回原节点或边，减少播种冗余并针对跨组传播通道。
text.en: Locate regions on the reduced network, then map back to original nodes or edges to limit redundant seeds and target intergroup channels.

audience.zh: 网络传播、粗粒化、影响力最大化与干预设计研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in contagion, coarse-graining, influence maximization and network intervention.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读17页官方PDF，未读另附补充材料。核心理论针对静态无向SIR及确定恢复；有限团在感染率小于1时仍有初始传播失败概率，不宜将近饱和或模拟吻合等同普遍严格无损。时间比较经过对齐。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 17-page publisher PDF, not separate supplements. Core theory uses static undirected SIR with deterministic recovery. Finite cliques below unit transmission retain seed-extinction risk; near-saturation or simulated agreement is not universal exactness. Timing comparisons are aligned. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

fulltext_review.title: Community-centric modeling of citation dynamics explains collective citation patterns across different knowledge systems
fulltext_review.version: Publisher Article in Press, first published online 2026-10-08; subject to further editing, not final Version of Record
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete 15-page publisher article, principal text, Methods, equations, Figures 1–4 and captions, references and declarations. Rendered Figures 2 and 4 inspected. Supplementary Information and peer-review file not read; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 为什么有些成果会沉睡多年后突然被发现？
question.en: Why are some works discovered only after years of obscurity?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把引文网络中的“遗忘”与“延迟认可”放进同一个生成模型：社区在知识空间中的移动，既可能远离旧成果，也可能重新接近被忽视的成果。对研究网络增长的人，这提供了一个可检验的机制视角。
值得借用的研究步骤是：跨系统寻找共同模式，用生成模型同时解释多个现象，再检查模型在哪些指标和条件下有效。它提醒我们，预测优势与机制解释需要分别验证。
en: Today’s pick puts aging and delayed recognition into one generative model: communities moving through knowledge space can leave older work behind or approach overlooked work. This offers a testable mechanism for researchers studying network growth.

Borrow its workflow: compare patterns across systems, explain several phenomena with one generative model, and inspect the metrics and conditions under which it works. Predictive gains and mechanistic explanations need separate checks.

heading.zh: 从社区变化解释节点命运

text.zh: 相似性、累积优势与适应度共同决定引用；不显式加入老化项，也能生成一定的衰退和再发现。
text.en: Relevance, cumulative advantage and fitness shape citations; some aging and rediscovery emerge without an explicit aging term.

heading.zh: 同时检验多种统计模式

text.zh: 比较科学、法律和专利的度分布、优先连接与“睡美人”现象，检验机制能否跨系统成立。
text.en: Compare degree distributions, preferential attachment and sleeping beauties across science, law and patents to test transfer across systems.

text.zh: 时间切分后比较误差与高被引识别；实验给定未来实际出版量和参考文献数，不能当作完全未知未来的预测。
text.en: Compare temporal prediction errors and high-impact retrieval; future publication and reference counts are given, so forecasting is conditional.

audience.zh: 网络生成模型、科学学与时序网络研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network growth, science of science and temporal networks.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读15页官方在线先行全文及方法，未读补充材料。跨系统统计一致不证明唯一因果机制，图4的预测优势也依赖系统与指标。本文尚待最终编辑；推荐为 AI 编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 15-page publisher Article in Press and Methods; supplements were not read. Shared patterns do not establish a unique causal mechanism, and Figure 4 gains depend on system and metric. Final editing is pending. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

fulltext_review.title: Missing links prediction: Comparing machine learning with physics-rooted approaches
fulltext_review.version: Physical Review Research 8, 043020 (2026), publisher version published online 2026-10-07
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete 28-page publisher article: main text, equations, Figures 1-20 and captions, Tables I-VI, Appendices A-F and references. Representative rendered figures inspected. No independent code or numerical reproduction.

question.zh: 相同信息条件下，复杂模型能带来多少额外收益？
question.en: With the same information, how much does a more complex model gain?

zh: 今天选它，因为缺失边预测是网络研究中的常见问题，而这篇论文把模型比较的起点放在“双方究竟看到了什么信息”上。对齐信息后，简单、可解释的网络模型也可能具有竞争力。
值得复用的是比较协议：先对齐可观测特征，再改变缺边采样方式，最后同时检查预测质量和计算成本。这套思路能帮助我们判断，性能提升究竟来自模型，还是来自信息与评价设置。

question.zh: 发现的平衡结构，来自数据还是算法的预设？
question.en: Does a balanced partition come from the data or the algorithm’s assumptions?

zh: 今天回选它，因为它提出一个直接影响网络分析结论的问题：如果算法本来就在寻找平衡分组，找到平衡能否算作理论证据？论文用18类群组关系和24个实证网络，让常被忽略的不平衡组织显现。
值得复用的是检验顺序：先检查方法预设，再比较带符号与无符号模型，最后分别评估三角形和群组尺度。它提醒我们，漂亮的分组结果也需要对照与不确定性。
en: Today’s archive pick asks a consequential question: if an algorithm seeks balanced groups, does finding them support balance theory? Its 18 pairwise relationship types and 24 empirical networks expose overlooked unbalanced organization.

Borrow the sequence: inspect methodological assumptions, compare signed and unsigned models, then assess triangles and groups separately. An appealing partition still needs controls and uncertainty checks.

text.zh: 对照平衡导向方法与度修正SBM，用已知分组的合成网络检验结果是否被目标函数牵引。
text.en: Contrast balance-oriented methods with degree-corrected SBMs, using synthetic networks with known groups to test objective-driven conclusions.

text.zh: 比较带符号模型与“无符号拓扑＋独立符号”基线的描述长度，不默认正负标签一定改善分组。
text.en: Compare description lengths against an unsigned-topology plus independent-sign baseline; do not assume signs necessarily improve grouping.

text.zh: 同时检查三角形平衡与群组挫折度；保留介观结构的零模型，再报告分组和关系类型的不确定性。
text.en: Check triadic balance and group-level frustration separately, use block-preserving null models, and report partition and type uncertainty.

audience.zh: 有符号网络、社区发现、社会平衡及实证网络研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in signed networks, community detection, social balance and empirical network analysis.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读15页官方PDF，未读另附补充材料。实证比较采用最大连通分量、无向化及二值化；关系类型依赖分组和模型，部分案例存在替代分组。结构解释不等于因果或传播验证。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 15-page publisher PDF, not separate supplements. Empirical comparisons use largest connected components, symmetrization and binarization. Types depend on partitions and models; some cases admit alternatives. Structural interpretations are not causal or diffusion tests. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 网络出现记忆，是单元的性质，还是耦合的结果？
question.en: Does network memory come from its elements or their coupling?

zh: 今天回选它，因为一个可调旁路就能把独立的迟滞单元变成相互作用网络，清楚展示局部形变如何经全局流量约束改变集体切换。它让“耦合从何而来”成为可以控制和检验的问题。
值得借鉴的是它的证据分层：先建立单元与无耦合基线，再比较状态切换路径和平均响应。尤其要注意，平均曲线越出原包络时，测试中的完整状态仍能恢复；不同的记忆判据不能互相替代。
en: Today’s archive pick uses a tunable bypass to turn independent hysterons into an interacting network. Local deformation changes collective switching through a global flow constraint, making the origin of coupling experimentally testable.

Borrow its layered checks: establish the element and uncoupled baseline, then compare state paths with average responses. Crossing the original envelope coexists with full-state recovery in tested protocols; different memory criteria are not interchangeable.

text.zh: 用流量与压差平衡解释远处单元为何相互影响，不把物理距离或直接接触当作唯一连接依据。
text.en: Use flow and pressure balance to explain distant interactions; physical proximity or contact need not define the effective coupling.

text.zh: 固定总流量时，无旁路串联单元可独立；固定总压差时则未必。对照必须和驱动方式一起定义。
text.en: Series elements can be independent without a bypass under fixed flow, but not necessarily under fixed pressure. Define the baseline with the drive.

heading.zh: 完整状态核验平均读数

text.zh: 结合切换图与状态向量区分反向切换、包络越界和回返点恢复，避免一条平均曲线承担多个结论。
text.en: Combine transition graphs and state vectors to distinguish counterswitching, envelope crossing and return-point recovery; one average curve cannot establish all three.

audience.zh: 网络动力学、集体记忆、流动网络与软物质研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network dynamics, collective memory, flow networks and soft matter.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读11页官方全文，未读独立补充材料和视频。结论基于低雷诺数、准静态流量驱动及有限阵列；复杂拓扑是后续方向。所测回返点均恢复，不能声称严格回返点记忆失效。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 11-page publisher article, not separate supplements or movies. Results concern low-Reynolds-number, quasistatic flow driving and finite arrays; complex topologies remain future work. Tested return points recover, so strict return-point memory failure is not established. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 拿不到完整流量，怎样重建一张可用的网络？
question.en: How can aggregate flows reconstruct a useful network?

zh: 今天选它，因为它直面网络研究常见的资料瓶颈：只有节点总量和区域信息，怎样生成可用于传播分析的稀疏加权网络？航空案例把约束选择、模型构造和任务检验连成一条清晰路径。
最值得复用的是分层验证：匹配已有约束之后，还要检查连接、空间模式和传播曲线。开放数据实验也提醒我们，先交代校准信息，再讨论重建效果。
en: Today’s pick addresses a recurring bottleneck: reconstructing a sparse weighted network from aggregate location and regional flows. Its aviation case connects constraint selection, model construction and epidemic-task validation.

Borrow the layered checks: after matching imposed constraints, test links, spatial patterns and spreading curves. The open-data experiment also makes it essential to state which calibration information remains available.

text.zh: 区分直接航班与实际起终点出行，避免把中转枢纽的流量当作最终人口混合。
text.en: Distinguish flight legs from origin-to-final-destination trips; transit-hub traffic need not represent population mixing.

text.zh: 先生成稀疏连接，再分配流量；节点强度与区域约束各自承担明确的模型角色。
text.en: Sample sparse links before assigning flows, giving location strengths and regional constraints explicit modeling roles.

text.zh: 对照真实网络上的传播峰值与空间分布，并将误差和随机模拟的自身波动比较。
text.en: Compare epidemic peaks and spatial patterns against the empirical network, using intrinsic simulation variability as a baseline.

audience.zh: 网络重构、加权网络、人口流动与传播动力学研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network reconstruction, weighted networks, mobility and spreading dynamics.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读9页官方早期在线全文，未读独立补充材料，未复现。网络基于2019年数据；开放数据测试仅覆盖739个区域，且连接密度仍按OAG校准，不能视为完全独立的开放数据重建。AI编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 9-page publisher Article in Press, not separate supplements; no reproduction. Networks use 2019 data. The open-data test covers 739 basins and still calibrates connectivity density against OAG; it is not a fully independent open-data reconstruction. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 怎样调局部速率，才能控制全局网络流？
question.en: How can local rates control global network flows?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络控制中常见的问题说具体了：改变一条边的跃迁速率，怎样影响全局流量与波动？论文给出统一的涨落响应框架，并用分子马达网络演示控制设计。
最值得带走的是先选独立观测量，再拆解噪声来源，最后检查控制的副作用。这条分析路径也能启发其他随机网络的模型设计。
en: Today’s pick makes a recurring control problem concrete: how does changing an edge’s transition rate alter global flows and fluctuations? A unified fluctuation–response framework connects these quantities and demonstrates control in a molecular-motor network.
Borrow the sequence: choose independent observables, identify noise sources, then check control side effects. This offers a reusable way to reason about other stochastic network models.

text.zh: 区分双向通量、净流与驻留概率，排除守恒带来的冗余，明确真正要控制的量。
text.en: Separate traffic, net flux and dwell probabilities; remove conservation redundancies before defining the control target.

text.zh: 分子马达案例区分等待时间与路径分支的贡献，提示不同负载下该调哪些跃迁。
text.en: The motor example separates timing and branching contributions, suggesting which transitions to target at different loads.

text.zh: 局部边、节点和循环调节协议展示如何改变目标观测量，并保持其余选定量不变。
text.en: Local edge, node and cycle protocols change a target observable while preserving the other selected observables.

audience.zh: 随机网络、非平衡动力学、网络流与控制研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in stochastic networks, nonequilibrium dynamics, network flows and control.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读7页正式全文，未读独立补充材料，未复现。框架针对长时稳态Markov跃迁网络；稠密图无普遍效率优势，形式对称性不意味着一般参数下的互易关系。AI编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read the seven-page version of record, not separate supplements; no reproduction. The framework concerns long-time stationary Markov jump networks. Dense graphs have no general efficiency advantage, and formal symmetry does not imply reciprocity for arbitrary parameters. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 干预改变行为，也会改变传播的网络吗？
question.en: Does an intervention also rewire its network?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络从干预的固定背景变成了需要测量的结果：在110个村落的随机健康教育试验中，总体度分布稳定，关系却随干预覆盖程度选择性地形成与断裂。
可借鉴的是分析顺序：先跟踪哪些边改变，再区分自己与邻居的干预暴露，最后检验变化是否跨关系类型、跨时间持续。只报告平均度，可能错过最有意义的变化。
en: Today’s pick treats the network as an intervention outcome. In a randomized health-education trial across 110 villages, aggregate degree distributions remained stable while ties selectively formed and dissolved with treatment coverage.

Borrow the analysis sequence: track changing edges, distinguish personal and neighboring exposure, then test persistence across relationship layers and time. Mean degree alone can miss the informative changes.

text.zh: 分别检查关系形成、维持和断裂，辨认被总体平均掩盖的连接重组。
text.en: Separate tie formation, persistence and dissolution to reveal rewiring hidden by aggregate averages.

text.zh: 两阶段随机化配合网络暴露分组，区分直接与溢出效应，并明确村间无干扰假设。
text.en: Pair two-stage randomization with exposure groups to distinguish direct and spillover effects, stating the no-between-village-interference assumption.

text.zh: 比较健康咨询、友谊和财务关系及后续随访，结合多重检验约束机制解释。
text.en: Compare advice, friendship and financial ties over follow-up, using multiple-testing checks to constrain mechanistic interpretations.

audience.zh: 社会网络、网络干预、传播与因果推断研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in social networks, interventions, spreading and causal inference.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读28页出版社PDF，含方法、扩展图表和内附报告摘要；未读独立SI，未复现。网络结果是原试验二次分析，剂量分组带探索性；自报关系及单地区样本限制外推。AI编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read all 28 PDF pages, including Methods, Extended Data and embedded Reporting Summary; separate SI not read, no reproduction. Network outcomes are secondary analysis with exploratory dose grouping; self-reported ties and one regional setting limit generalization. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 从时间序列生成的网络，怎样才算具有记忆？
question.en: When does a network built from time series have memory?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把序模式转移网络与储备池计算联系起来，并追问“记忆”究竟对应哪个状态、怎样测量。对用网络表示时间序列的研究者，这比再增加一个预测精度指标更有启发。
可复用的是三步检查：先把必要历史纳入状态，再用经验混合时间检查遗忘速度，最后按合法后继集合设随机基线。结构约束带来的高准确率，不能直接当成学习能力。
en: Today’s pick connects ordinal-pattern transition networks with reservoir computing and asks which state carries memory and how to measure it. This offers a useful framework for researchers who represent time series as networks.

Borrow three checks: include the necessary history in the state, measure empirical mixing, and set chance performance using legal successors. High accuracy created by structural constraints should not be mistaken for learned predictive skill.

text.zh: 延迟嵌入需要保留兼容历史；单个序模式不足以描述完整记忆。
text.en: Delay embedding requires a compatibility history; one ordinal pattern is not the complete memory state.

text.zh: 结合谱隙与直接迭代的混合时间，警惕理论上界在有限样本下过松。
text.en: Pair the spectral gap with directly measured mixing time; theoretical bounds can be loose for finite samples.

text.zh: 用每步合法后继集合计算机会水平，避免把编码限制误判为预测优势。
text.en: Compute chance from each step’s legal successors to separate coding constraints from predictive gains.

audience.zh: 时间序列网络、符号动力学、储备池计算与网络推断研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in time-series networks, symbolic dynamics, reservoir computing and network inference.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读14页正式PDF，含图表与推导；未读独立补充文件，未复现或独立验算。本文为Perspective，一步序模式预测用于说明概念，不是优于优化储备池的性能证明；遗忘结论有遍历性条件。AI编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read the complete 14-page publisher PDF, including figures, tables and derivations; separate supplements not read, no reproduction or independent proof verification. This Perspective uses one-step ordinal prediction as illustration, not a superiority benchmark against optimized reservoirs. Fading memory requires ergodicity conditions. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 一场局部暴雨，怎样演变成全网延误？
question.en: How can local rainfall become network-wide delay?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把降雨这个外部空间场接入网络动力学，让“哪里下雨”和“延误怎样传播、被吸收”在同一模型里相遇。它为气候风险与基础设施韧性研究提供了一条可复用的建模路径。
值得带走的是：拆分扰动生成、传播和吸收，按时间留出数据检验，再区分动态脆弱性与人口加权风险。模型的崩溃相不能当成真实铁路已被验证的崩溃阈值。
en: Today’s pick couples a spatial rainfall field to network dynamics, connecting where disruption originates with how delays spread and dissipate. It offers a reusable modeling route for climate risk and infrastructure resilience.

Borrow the separation of generation, propagation and absorption; validate on later data; and distinguish dynamic vulnerability from population-weighted risk. A model collapse regime is not an empirically established threshold for real railways.

heading.en: Put the external field into dynamics

text.zh: 沿线路累计降雨影响，把局部冲击与网络传播、容量吸收明确分开。
text.en: Integrate rainfall along links and separate local forcing from network propagation and capacity-driven absorption.

text.zh: 用后续年份测试，并报告少雨日和不同铁路系统上预测失效的边界。
text.en: Test on later data and report limits on low-rain days and across different railway systems.

text.zh: 局部扰动后的全网延误，再乘人口暴露，可得到不同于中心性的治理优先序。
text.en: Combine network-wide delay after local shocks with population exposure to obtain priorities beyond centrality.

audience.zh: 网络韧性、级联传播、交通网络与气候风险研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network resilience, cascades, transportation and climate risk.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读9页正式PDF及全部图表；未读独立补充材料，未复现或独立验算。简化模型忽略调度、取消与改道；真实数据未达到模型无界崩溃条件。AI编辑荐读。
reading_caveat.en: Read all nine publisher-PDF pages and figures/tables; separate supplements not read, no reproduction or independent derivation checks. The simplified model omits dispatching, cancellations and rerouting; observed data do not reach its divergent-collapse condition. AI editorial guidance.

question.zh: 重构出调控网络后，怎样找出协同工作的模块？
question.en: After reconstructing a regulatory network, how do we find cooperating modules?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络重构与模块解释接起来：保留不同伪时间滞后的调控信息，再识别共同作用的转录因子与靶基因，而不只交付一张静态连边图。
可复用的思路是先用生物先验约束候选边，再以张量表达多尺度关系，并分别检验边恢复、关键节点和稳定性。推断关联仍需实验验证。
en: Today’s pick connects network reconstruction to module interpretation: retain regulation across pseudotime lags, then identify cooperating transcription factors and target programs instead of stopping at a static edge map.

Borrow its sequence of prior-constrained inference, tensor representation and separate checks of edge recovery, key regulators and stability. Inferred associations still require experimental validation.

text.zh: 将因子、靶基因与伪时间滞后组成张量，用Tucker分解识别协同调控程序。
text.en: Represent factors, targets and pseudotime lags as a tensor; use Tucker decomposition to identify regulatory programs.

text.zh: 用染色质可及性与结合基序限定候选边，并检查移除先验后的表现。
text.en: Restrict candidate edges with chromatin accessibility and binding motifs, and compare inference without this prior.

text.zh: 同时考察连边、关键因子与稳定性；AUPR优势不等于所有F1比较都显著。
text.en: Check edges, key regulators and stability separately; favorable AUPR does not imply significant gains in every F1 comparison.

audience.zh: 网络重构、动态网络、模块发现及单细胞多组学研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network inference, dynamic networks, module discovery and single-cell multiomics.

reading_caveat.en: Read all 20 pages and six main figures of the publisher’s Article in Press, not the final edited version. question.zh: 优先连接允许落点偏移后，经典网络结构还稳健吗？
question.en: Does preferential attachment remain robust when the final endpoint can shift?

zh: 今天回选它，因为一个很小的机制改变，就能检验经典模型里常被忽略的假设：新节点选中的目标，是否必须就是最终的连接端点。
值得借鉴的是把选择与落边分开建模，用固定重定向作对照，再检查有限尺寸效应。读者也能学习如何区分严格结果、数值证据与猜想。
en: Today’s archive pick uses a small mechanism change to test an overlooked assumption: must the initially selected node also be the final attachment endpoint?

Borrow its separation of target selection from edge placement, constant-redirection controls and finite-size checks. Its explicit distinction between rigorous results, numerical evidence and conjectures is equally useful.

text.zh: 先选目标，再允许局部重定向；微观规则的细节可能改变宏观拓扑。
text.en: Select a target, then allow local redirection: details of microscopic rules can change macroscopic topology.

text.zh: 固定与度依赖重定向并列比较，帮助辨认结构变化来自哪项假设。
text.en: Compare constant and degree-dependent redirection to identify which assumption drives structural changes.

text.zh: 将定理、模拟与猜想分别标明；临界附近的有限尺寸偏差尤其值得留意。
text.en: Label theorems, simulations and conjectures separately, with particular care near finite-size crossovers.

audience.zh: 网络增长、生成模型、优先连接及理论与模拟结合的研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network growth, generative models, preferential attachment and theory–simulation comparisons.

question.zh: 预测得准，推断出的网络就可靠吗？
question.en: Does accurate prediction make an inferred network reliable?

zh: 今天选它，因为网络推断很容易只报告一个漂亮的预测分数。这份复用研究把注意力转向：换一批样本、删去部分先验后，哪些结构仍然站得住？
可以借用它的验证思路：分别测量预测表现与结构稳定性，再用先验扰动、重复求解和聚合对照定位脆弱环节。稳定的结果仍不等于真实的因果网络。
en: Today’s pick tackles a common blind spot in network inference: a strong prediction score can hide fragile structure. What remains when samples change or prior edges are missing?

Borrow its separation of prediction from structural stability, then use prior perturbations, repeated solves and aggregation controls to locate weaknesses. Stable outputs still do not establish a true causal network.

text.zh: 区分预测、结构一致性和生物真实性，避免把同一种分数当成全部证据。
text.en: Distinguish prediction, structural consistency and biological truth rather than relying on one score.

text.zh: 改变先验完整性与样本组合，检查结论对数据和约束有多敏感。
text.en: Vary prior completeness and sample composition to expose sensitivity to data and constraints.

text.zh: 用聚合降低求解波动，用选择性回补检查过度剪枝的信息损失。
text.en: Use aggregation against solver variability and selective re-expansion to probe pruning losses.

audience.zh: 网络重构、生物网络及关心模型稳健性和可复现性的研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network reconstruction, biological networks and model robustness.

question.zh: 圈内协同与跨圈确认并存时，结构多样性会怎样改变传播相变？
question.en: How does structural diversity reshape contagion when reinforcement acts within and across social circles?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把常被分开处理的两类高阶强化放进同一模型：圈内多人协同与跨圈多源确认。两者竞争使结构多样性的作用呈U形，而非简单的单调促进或抑制。
最值得复用的是它的机制拆分和验证链：固定度序列只重排邻域结构，用消息传递推导阈值，再以双初值滞后、Monte Carlo和有限尺寸标度交叉检查。
en: Today's pick combines two higher-order mechanisms that are often studied separately: synergy within a circle and confirmation across circles. Their competition makes structural diversity produce a U-shaped response instead of a simple monotonic effect.

Its reusable lesson is the validation chain: alter neighborhood structure while preserving degree, derive thresholds by message passing, then cross-check with two-initial-condition hysteresis, Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling.

text.zh: 把圈内协同与跨圈确认写成独立机制，避免用一个高阶参数混合不同社会强化。
text.en: Model within-circle synergy and cross-circle confirmation separately instead of blending distinct reinforcement mechanisms.

text.zh: 保持度序列和全局连通，只调节邻域连通分量，用于隔离结构多样性的作用。
text.en: Preserve degree and global connectivity while tuning neighborhood components to isolate structural diversity.

text.zh: 结合理论阈值、双初值滞后、模拟和有限尺寸标度，区分真实突变与数值假象。
text.en: Combine thresholds, two-initial-condition hysteresis, simulation and finite-size scaling to test abrupt transitions.

audience.zh: 高阶网络、社会传播、消息传递方法及相变研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in higher-order networks, social contagion, message passing and phase transitions.

fulltext_review.version: Publisher Article in Press; citable early article, explicitly awaiting final edited version. Official online date 21 October 2026; not claimed to be final edited Version of Record.

question.zh: 简单的节点状态，怎样产生不均匀的群体互动？
question.en: How can simple node states generate uneven group interactions?

zh: 今天选它，因为复杂时间统计未必需要先假定复杂记忆：节点只在高、低活跃间切换，群体层面就能出现更长的事件间隔尾部和缓慢自相关。这个从微观机制推到可观测量的过程很适合作为建模起点。
可借用的思路是先建立可解析的最小基线，再同时检查事件率、间隔变异系数和自相关，并按群体规模分层。多项趋势相似仍不意味着已经识别真实生成规则。
en: This paper makes a useful modeling point: complex event statistics need not begin with complex memory. Nodes switching between high and low activity can already yield longer event-time tails and slowly decaying autocorrelation at group level.
Borrow its minimal analytic baseline, then check event rates, interval variability and autocorrelation together across group sizes. Similar trends do not identify the true generating rule.

text.zh: 比较全员高活跃的 AND 规则与按活跃比例变化的 LIN 规则，明确群体事件如何产生。
text.en: Compare an all-members-high AND rule with a high-state-fraction LIN rule to make event generation explicit.

heading.zh: 用多个统计量约束模型

text.zh: 联合看事件率、间隔变异系数和自相关，减少单一长尾图带来的机制误判。
text.en: Combine event rates, interval variability and autocorrelation instead of inferring mechanisms from one tail plot.

text.zh: 实证比较是定性检验；允许参数随群体规模变化时，不同规则可给出相似趋势。
text.en: Empirical checks are qualitative; different rules can resemble each other when rates vary with group size.

audience.zh: 时间网络、高阶互动、事件序列建模及传播动力学研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in temporal networks, higher-order interactions, event sequences and spreading dynamics.

fulltext_review.title: Structure-coefficient theorem for evolutionary games on dynamic networks
fulltext_review.version: Publisher typeset Article PDF; Published online date remains a placeholder in this supplied file. Official article page confirms 22 October 2026. Final edited Version of Record status not independently established from the PDF.

question.zh: 关系不断切换时，什么结构能让合作更容易演化？
question.en: Which changing network structures make cooperation easier to evolve?

zh: 选它是因为它提供了一个可复用的拆解方式：先固定网络切换、更新规则和突变设置，把它们的影响写成三个结构系数，再比较不同收益矩阵。对要扫描多种博弈的研究，这比每次重新展开整套模型更有启发。
另一点值得借用的是对照设计：用同构静态网络的不同节点配置隔离时间变化的作用，再扫描切换速度。动态核周结构提示，结构优势在人之间轮换也能影响合作；不能只看静态中心性或一张聚合图。
en: This paper offers a reusable decomposition: fix network switching, updating and mutation, encode their effects in three structure coefficients, then compare payoff matrices. That separation is especially useful when studying several games under one temporal-network mechanism.

Borrow its control design as well: compare isomorphic static configurations to isolate temporality, then scan switching rates. Rotating access to core positions can change cooperation, so static centrality or one aggregate graph may miss the mechanism.

text.zh: 弱选择下以三个系数组织网络、更新与突变影响，便于比较多种博弈。
text.en: Under weak selection, three coefficients organize network, update and mutation effects for comparisons across games.

text.zh: 用同构静态配置和切换速度扫描，区分结构本身与结构轮换的贡献。
text.en: Use isomorphic static controls and switching-rate scans to separate structure from its temporal rotation.

text.zh: 系数来自中性两、三节点概率等线性系统，模型压缩不等于常数计算成本。
text.en: Coefficients require neutral two- and three-node probability systems; a compact theorem does not imply constant computational cost.

audience.zh: 演化博弈、时间网络、合作演化与随机过程建模研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in evolutionary games, temporal networks, cooperation and stochastic-process modeling.

fulltext_review.title: Emergence and coexistence of periodic and unstructured motion in future-avoiding random walks
fulltext_review.version: Physical Review E 114, 044219 (2026), publisher version published online 2026-10-23

question.zh: 未来驱动的路径互动，怎样自发形成周期与无序共存？
question.en: How can future-driven path interactions self-organize periodic and unstructured motion?

zh: 今天选它，因为论文把网络上的路径互动与共享出行联系起来：车辆不是回避走过的历史，而是在分配请求时相互避让计划中的未来轨迹。周期路线和无序路线因此可以在同一系统中共存。
可借用的分析顺序是先用边使用率检验单路线结构，再用加权复现图识别周期性，最后用环网络上的方向改变概率建立近似。这样能把“看起来有规律”拆成结构指标、动力学状态和机制解释。
en: I recommend this paper because it connects network path interactions with shared mobility: routes avoid one another’s planned futures during request assignment, allowing periodic and unstructured routes to coexist in one system.

A reusable workflow is to test single-route structure with link usage, detect periodicity with value-weighted recurrence plots, and then build a direction-change approximation on a ring. It separates visual regularity, dynamical state and mechanism.

heading.zh: 把路径互动写成网络动力学
heading.en: Model path interactions as network dynamics

text.zh: 未来轨迹的相互避让把请求分配、路线记忆和网络拓扑连在一起，适合研究非振荡个体如何出现集体结构。
text.en: Future-trajectory avoidance links request assignment, route memory and topology, offering a way to study collective structure without intrinsically oscillatory units.

heading.zh: 用复现图区分周期与无序

text.zh: 加权复现矩阵保留重复节点的身份，平均对角线长度再给出路线周期性比例，比只看时间序列更容易定位结构。
text.en: A value-weighted recurrence matrix keeps recurring node identities, while mean diagonal length quantifies periodicity more directly than a time series alone.

text.zh: 环网络上的方向改变概率准确抓住转变位置，但高估转变陡峭度，提醒我们把近似的趋势和精确预测分开报告。
text.en: The ring approximation captures the transition location but overestimates its sharpness, a useful reminder to report trends separately from exact prediction.

audience.zh: 网络动力学、路径规划、时间网络与共享出行建模研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network dynamics, routing, temporal networks and shared-mobility modeling.

question.zh: 推荐系统的稀疏交互思想，怎样帮助我们学习细粒度的基因调控图？
question.en: How can sparse interaction ideas from recommender systems help learn fine-grained gene-regulatory graphs?

zh: 我推荐它，因为文章把每个细胞的染色质可及性与基因表达重写成二部交互图，再用带生物属性的图 Transformer 学习 peak–gene 关系；这让“图模型如何服务具体机制问题”变得很清楚。
可复用的建模经验是把节点属性、先验边和稀疏监督分开做消融，并用跨细胞类型、跨数据集的零样本测试检查迁移。文中结果仍是计算基准与生物学解释，不能替代实验验证。
en: I recommend this paper because it recasts each cell’s chromatin accessibility and gene expression as a bipartite interaction graph, then uses a biology-aware graph transformer to learn peak–gene links. It makes the path from graph modeling to a concrete mechanism question unusually clear.

A reusable design is to ablate node attributes, prior edges and sparse supervision separately, then test transfer across unseen cell types and datasets. The evidence is computational benchmarking plus biological interpretation; it does not replace experimental validation.

heading.zh: 把跨模态关系显式成图

text.zh: RNA 节点与 ATAC 节点组成二部图，边和属性分别承载先验与生物信息。
text.en: Represent RNA and ATAC nodes in a bipartite graph, keeping prior edges and biological attributes distinct.

heading.en: Test where the signal comes from

text.zh: 分别移除属性、先验边、方向注意力和剪枝模块，观察性能与可解释性如何变化。
text.en: Remove attributes, prior edges, directional attention and pruning separately to track their effects on performance and interpretation.

text.zh: 跨未见细胞类型和跨数据集直接测试，检验模型是否学到可迁移的调控模式。
text.en: Test unseen cell types and cross-dataset transfer without fine-tuning to ask whether learned regulatory patterns travel.

audience.en: Researchers in graph learning, network inference, single-cell multi-omics and regulatory-network modeling.

question.zh: 扩散模型从记忆到泛化的转变，能否用联想记忆网络的能量景观解释？
question.en: Can associative-memory energy landscapes explain how diffusion models move from memorization to generalization?

zh: 我推荐它，因为文章把 Dense Associative Memory、Hopfield 能量景观与扩散模型放进同一个网络动力学框架，直接追踪记忆化、伪状态和生成式泛化之间的关系。
可复用的阅读路径是先看能量景观和容量预测，再对照 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、LSUN-CHURCH 与 Stable Diffusion 案例，最后检查理想化 score 学习假设是否限制解释范围。
en: I recommend this paper because it places Dense Associative Memory, Hopfield energy landscapes and diffusion models in one network-dynamics framework, tracing memorization, spurious states and generative generalization together.

A reusable reading path is to start with the energy landscape and capacity predictions, compare the MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, LSUN-CHURCH and Stable Diffusion cases, then check how the idealized score-learning assumptions limit the interpretation.

heading.zh: 把扩散过程写成吸引子动力学

text.zh: DenseAM/Hopfield 能量景观提供了连接记忆检索、伪状态和生成过程的统一语言。
text.en: DenseAM and Hopfield energy landscapes provide one language for memory retrieval, spurious states and generation.

heading.zh: 用多层数据检验相变图景

text.zh: 从二维 toy model 到四个自然数据集再到 Stable Diffusion，逐层检查理论现象是否出现。
text.en: The paper checks the proposed picture from a 2D toy model through four natural datasets to Stable Diffusion.

text.zh: 作者指出理论依赖理想化 score 学习条件，也没有证明伪状态是泛化的因果驱动。
text.en: The authors state that the theory relies on idealized score learning and does not establish spurious states as a causal driver of generalization.

audience.en: Researchers in diffusion models, associative memory, network dynamics and generative-model theory.

The theory relies on idealized score learning, and a causal role for spurious states in generalization is not established; a later Version of Record may replace this version. AI editorial guidance.

fulltext_review.version: PNAS 123 (44), e2321155123, publisher Version of Record; published online 2026-10-26

question.zh: 局部旱灾或政策变化，如何经市场和运输网络改变远处群体的粮食安全？
question.en: How do local droughts and policy changes alter distant food security through markets and transport networks?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把“冲击沿网络传播”落实到生产者、仓储商、运输商和消费者的不同目标，说明总产量增加与弱势群体受益并不等价。
值得借鉴的是先拆分生产区与市场区，再追踪价格、流量和福利的变化；同时把反事实基线、需求弹性与行为假设写清，避免把情景模型当作精确预测。
en: I recommend this Perspective because it makes network shock propagation concrete through the different objectives of producers, storage operators, distributors and consumers; greater total supply need not benefit vulnerable groups.

A reusable approach is to separate production zones from marketsheds, then trace prices, flows and welfare. Keep the counterfactual baseline, demand elasticities and behavioral assumptions explicit when interpreting scenarios.

heading.zh: 把传播路径与行动者放在一起

text.zh: DECO 显式连接农业区、市场与道路基础设施，用多参与者目标解释冲击如何跨区域传递。
text.en: DECO explicitly connects production zones, markets and roads, using multiple actor objectives to explain regional transmission.

heading.zh: 检查谁获益、谁承受成本
heading.en: Track who gains and who bears costs

text.zh: 运输扩容、出口放松和灌溉案例展示总量指标之外的分配效应，提醒网络韧性分析同时观察消费和收益。
text.en: Transport, export and irrigation scenarios reveal distributional effects that aggregate indicators miss; examine consumption and income alongside system totals.

text.zh: 需求弹性、理性行为与局部均衡假设影响结论；埃塞俄比亚到马里的迁移也需要重建本地数据与参数。
text.en: Demand elasticities, rational behavior and partial-equilibrium assumptions shape the results; transfer from Ethiopia to Mali requires local data and parameterization.

audience.zh: 研究网络韧性、级联冲击、社会生态系统和跨部门情景建模的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying network resilience, cascading shocks, socioecological systems and cross-sector scenario modeling.

AI editorial guidance.

fulltext_review.title: Neuromodulation-inspired gated associative memory networks: Extended memory retrieval and emergent multistability
fulltext_review.version: PNAS 123 (44) e2607559123, publisher Version of Record; published 2026-10-27
fulltext_review.read_scope: Read all 10 pages: Model and Background, Main Results, thermodynamic-limit DMFT, emergent continuous multistable attractors, Conclusion and Outlook, Materials and Methods, Data availability, Figures 1-4, tables and references. Rendered visual checks of pages 7-8 (Figs. 3-4) and inspected figure captions. Supporting information was not read or executed; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 活动依赖门控如何改变联想记忆网络的容量、稳定性与吸引子几何？
question.en: How does activity-dependent gating change capacity, stability and attractor geometry in associative-memory networks?

zh: 这篇文章把神经调制抽象为乘性门控，展示门控如何把过载网络中的短暂高重叠状态稳定下来，并让最终检索状态连续依赖初始线索。
可复用的方法是将多体模拟与动力学平均场理论相互校验，再用固定随机实现、只改变初始状态的二维流图检查多稳态；但有限斜率门控主要是长寿命状态，二值极限才是永久稳定。
en: The paper models neuromodulation as multiplicative gating and shows how it stabilizes high-overlap transients in overloaded networks, with final retrieval varying continuously with the initial cue.

A useful workflow is to cross-check many-body simulations with dynamical mean-field theory, then hold disorder fixed while varying only the initial state to test multistability. At finite gate slope the states are long-lived; permanence is an idealized binary-limit result.

text.zh: 门控在超过经典容量的区域保持量级为一的检索重叠，绕开无门控网络的灾难性失忆。
text.en: Gating preserves order-one retrieval beyond the classical capacity where the ungated network loses memory.

text.zh: 关闭子群冻结并稳定活跃神经元，解释了短暂吸引子为何可被保留。
text.en: A dynamically selected closed subpopulation stabilizes active neurons and preserves otherwise transient attractor structure.

text.zh: 固定网络实现并只改变初始状态的流图显示，门控网络可形成连续的稳定固定点云。
text.en: Flow diagrams with fixed disorder and varied initial states show a continuous cloud of stable fixed points.

audience.zh: 研究联想记忆、递归网络、网络动力学和神经形态计算的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying associative memory, recurrent networks, network dynamics and neuromorphic computing.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读出版社正式版 10 页正文、图 1–4、方法、数据声明与参考文献，并检查图 3–4 页面；未读补充信息，未运行代码或独立复现。有限门控斜率下稳定性是长寿命而非永久；模型采用全连接 Hebbian 耦合和随机门控耦合，生物适用性仍需结构化连接数据检验。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 10-page publisher Version of Record, Figs. 1-4, methods, data statement and references, with visual checks of the pages containing Figs. 3-4. Supplementary information was not read and code was not run or independently reproduced. Finite gate slopes yield long-lived rather than permanent states; the model uses fully connected Hebbian couplings and random gate couplings, so biological applicability still needs structured connectivity data.

question.zh: 如何在控制活跃度与层密度后，区分多层社会网络中的主动联系分配与他人依赖？
question.en: How can we distinguish outgoing social effort from incoming reliance across relationship layers while accounting for activity and layer density?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把“联系有多少”和“联系分配到哪一层”分开，让多层社会角色的估计对象更明确。
值得借鉴的是同一数据下比较出向与入向角色，再用组成坐标、人口属性和地理关联检验差异。横截面年龄组差异不能直接解释为个体生命周期变化。
en: This paper separates how much people interact from how they distribute interactions across layers, making the role estimand explicit.

A useful workflow compares outgoing and incoming roles on the same data, then checks compositional coordinates, demographic associations and geography. Cross-sectional age-group differences do not establish individual life-course trajectories.

text.zh: 发送者、接收者与层密度效应吸收联系量差异；单纯形因子刻画相对层分配，避免把活跃度当作角色。
text.en: Sender, receiver and layer effects account for activity and density; simplex factors describe relative layer allocation, avoiding an activity-based interpretation of roles.

text.zh: 在同一套有向多层数据中比较两种角色，并用组成坐标分析社会属性与空间组织，适合借鉴为角色分析流程。
text.en: Compare both role directions on the same directed multiplex data, then use compositional coordinates to examine demographic and spatial organization.

text.zh: 村庄横截面样本揭示关联及方向不对称，但不能据此推断因果、个体随年龄的变化或城市网络中的普遍规律。
text.en: The village cross-section reveals associations and directional asymmetries; it does not establish causality, within-person aging trajectories or generality to urban networks.

audience.zh: 研究多层网络、社会角色、网络推断与组成数据分析的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying multiplex networks, social roles, network inference and compositional data analysis.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读正式出版版 11 页正文、方法、讨论与参考文献，核对图 1–5 及图注；未读独立补充信息，未独立复现。数据来自洪都拉斯村庄的非概率横截面样本，并限制于聚合强连通分量；外推到城市或其他关系层尚待验证。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 11-page publisher version, including main text, methods, discussion, references and Figures 1–5 with captions. Separate supporting information was not read and results were not independently reproduced. The nonprobability cross-section of Honduran villages is restricted to the aggregate strongly connected component; generality to urban settings or other relationship layers remains untested.
