fulltext_review.title: Potential energy landscape networks of confined vortex matter
fulltext_review.version: PNAS publisher Version of Record, published 2026-10-29
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete seven-page main article, Results, Methods 2.1-2.4, conclusion, references and Figures 1-4 with captions; rendered checks of pages 1, 3-6. Separate SI not read; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 能量景观如何变成网络，帮助理解受限粒子系统的稳定性？
question.en: How can energy-landscape networks help explain stability in confined particle systems?

zh: 今天选它，因为网络的节点是完整的亚稳态构型，而非单个涡旋；先选对状态空间，才谈结构与稳定性的联系。
可借鉴的是把 k-core 分层、度信息量和升温模拟放在一起对照。深核包含基态是文中系统的经验结果，不能当作任意能量景观的定理。
en: The useful move is to make entire metastable configurations the nodes, rather than individual vortices. Choosing the state space makes the structural question precise.
Compare k-core shells and degree information with heating simulations. Ground-state membership in the deepest core is an observation in the studied systems, not a theorem for arbitrary landscapes.

text.zh: 局部能量极小值作节点，一级鞍点连接状态；这种映射把高维构型问题转为可分析的状态网络。
text.en: Local energy minima become nodes and first-order saddles connect states, turning a high-dimensional configuration problem into an analyzable state network.

heading.zh: 比较结构与物理稳定性

text.zh: 将 k-core、度信息量与熔化模拟并置，检查几何、粒子数和约束强度如何共同改变稳定构型。
text.en: Juxtapose k-core structure, degree information and melting simulations to examine how geometry, particle number and confinement jointly change stable configurations.

text.zh: 固定粒子数的 London 点涡旋与硬壁约束给出具体适用条件；强约束下的稳定序列不能只从对称性猜测。
text.en: Fixed-number London point vortices and hard walls define the model scope; under strong confinement, symmetry alone cannot identify the stable sequence.

audience.zh: 研究状态空间网络、网络结构与动力学、能量景观及受限多体系统的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying state-space networks, network structure and dynamics, energy landscapes and confined many-body systems.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读用户提供的正式出版版 7 页全文、结果、方法 2.1–2.4、结论、参考文献及图 1–4，并查看渲染页。独立补充材料未读，未独立复现。结果限于文中点涡旋与约束模型；深核与基态的联系不是普适保证。
reading_caveat.en: Read the user-provided seven-page publisher article, including Results, Methods 2.1-2.4, conclusion, references and Figures 1-4, with rendered-page checks. Separate supporting information was not read and results were not independently reproduced. Findings concern the studied point-vortex confinement models; deep-core membership does not universally guarantee the ground state.

question.zh: 高阶行为的信号，能告诉我们真实作用发生在哪一阶吗？
question.en: Can a higher-order behavioral signal tell us the order of the underlying mechanism?

heading.zh: 学会设计机制关闭对照

text.zh: 关闭目标阶机制，保留其他阶作用，再检查信号是否消失。图 4 的对照能启发我们检验指标是否受到跨阶效应干扰。
text.en: Disable the target-order mechanism while retaining other orders, then check whether the signal disappears. Figure 4 suggests a control for cross-order interference.

heading.en: Match the measure to the task

text.zh: 将“检测到依赖”和“找对机制阶数”分开评估。图 5 中协同信息更能区分阶数，提醒我们按推断目标选择指标。
text.en: Evaluate dependence detection separately from correct mechanism-order identification. Synergy is more selective for order in Figure 5: choose measures for the inference task.

text.zh: 改变测量节点组的大小，比较相邻阶的响应。若更大的组仍有信号，就应检查指标能否定位具体阶数；迁移到自己的模型时也可沿用这一测试。
text.en: Vary measured group size and compare neighboring orders. If larger groups retain a signal, test whether the measure can locate the specific order. Reuse this check in your own model.

audience.zh: 高阶网络、传播动力学、信息论与网络推断研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in higher-order networks, contagion dynamics, information theory and network inference.

reading_caveat.zh: 依据用户提供的正式出版版 PDF（18 页）阅读全文，涵盖正文、附录 A–E 与图 1–13。推荐与可复用经验为 AI 编辑意见；结果限于文中测试的 SIS 与随机高阶网络，未独立复现实验。
reading_caveat.en: Based on a full reading of the user-provided publisher PDF (18 pages), including the main text, Appendices A-E and Figures 1-13. Recommendations and reusable lessons are AI editorial judgments. Findings apply to the tested SIS and random higher-order networks; experiments were not independently reproduced.

zh: 今天选它，因为它用 SIS 模型给出一个值得警惕的反例：某阶机制已关闭，该阶行为信号仍可能存在。
值得带走的是它的验证思路：用机制开关与跨阶比较，检验指标究竟识别了什么。做高阶网络推断时，这套对照值得借鉴。
en: Today's pick offers a revealing SIS counterexample: a signal can persist at an order whose mechanism has been disabled.

Take away its validation strategy: use mechanism switches and cross-order comparisons to test what a measure actually identifies. These controls are worth borrowing for higher-order network inference.
